name: Superintendent General Niigaki
source:
The current Superintendent General of the National Police Agency.
He witnessed his predecessor died because of the Cult incident and has made a secret deal with the cult, in which the Cult would halt activities in exchange for the police's blind eyes.

[spoiler] In fact, he is a human supremacist who wants to get rid of other races. He founded the Cult to help him achieve this goal and had his predecessor assassinated when the latter tried to wipe out the Cult. [/spoiler]
